title: James Webb Space Telescope helps detect the most distant Fast Radio Burst ever seen — and scientists are surprised by its source
caption:
Astronomers have tracked the most distant Fast Radio Burst ever detected. By using the James Webb Space Telescope, they traced this ancient signal back to a tiny, star-forming galaxy 11 billion light-years away.
